sql: SELECT name, MAX(sql) AS schema FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' GROUP BY name
rows: CREATE TABLE release_log (date TEXT, change TEXT)
CREATE TABLE search_daily (date TEXT, platform TEXT, country TEXT, ranker TEXT, searches INTEGER, clicks INTEGER)

sql: SELECT date, change, COUNT(*) AS records FROM release_log GROUP BY date, change
rows: ranker v2 rolled out to 100% of traffic

sql: SELECT date, COUNT(*) AS cells, SUM(searches) AS searches, SUM(clicks) AS clicks, COUNT(DISTINCT platform || ':' || country) AS segments, SUM(CASE WHEN searches IS NULL OR clicks IS NULL OR searches < 0 OR clicks < 0 OR clicks > searches THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_cells FROM search_daily GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

SELECT CASE WHEN date < '2026-09-28' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, platform, country, ranker, COUNT(*) AS days, SUM(searches) AS n, SUM(clicks) AS k FROM search_daily WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-09-21' AND '2026-10-04' GROUP BY period, platform, country, ranker ORDER BY platform, country, period

SELECT CASE WHEN date < '2026-09-28' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, platform, SUM(searches) AS n, SUM(clicks) AS k FROM search_daily WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-09-21' AND '2026-10-04' GROUP BY period, platform
